description: This file contains functions for upgrading Netgear Orbi devices, including flashing kernel and root filesystem, handling loop devices, and formatting new root partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process, calls flashing function, and reboots the device upon success.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Handles flashing of kernel and root filesystem for the upgrade, mounts the new root, and updates config files.
